body.name: Compliance monitoring processes defined and implemented
body.description: Control effectiveness is monitored on an ongoing basis.
body.detail: Compliance posture is computed from the live system on request, not maintained as a spreadsheet.
observations: Every control in this catalogue carries a verifier that inspects the running deployment; results are recomputed on each call.
Controls nothing can verify are reported as unclaimed rather than assumed to pass, and they lower the readiness score.
